paragraphs.text: Building got cheap, but watching people didn’t.
Agents can make almost anything now. That moves the bottleneck from making to knowing what’s worth making, and you only learn that from real use.
wants agents reading production traces and improving from there.
would rather look out the window and see how people use the product, with metrics as a secondary guide.
Both want the same input, and I side with Karri on the order. Traces show what people did. Watching shows what they meant.
An agent can clear every issue in a trace and still polish the wrong thing. Rauch says it himself: you can burn tokens on optimizations no one will care about.
So the designer’s week changes. Less time in the file. More time next to someone using the thing.
